Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Maria Laskarina was the maternal grandmother of Constantine Palaiologos based on a misinterpretation of the search results. In Step 3, the WebSurfer reported that a search for "Anna of Hungary parents Britannica" returned results mentioning "B la IV of Hungary and Maria Laskarina." The Planner failed to recognize that this referred to a different historical figure (Anna of Bohemia and Hungary, daughter of Bláha IV) rather than the Byzantine Empress Anna of Hungary (daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman). Instead of verifying the specific Anna of Hungary (Byzantine Empress) or noting the discrepancy, the Planner accepted the incorrect lineage (Maria Laskarina) as the answer, leading to a wrong solution.
